messages:
Priya Shah: Quick sync — I want to propose a tighter postmortem follow-up process. Too many action items are slipping or not clearly owned. Suggestion: a single timeline template + mandatory owner + SLA for remediation updates. Thoughts?

Sam Ortiz: +1. Can we make the template small and machine-readable so we can auto-surface overdue items in Slack? e.g., a 72h/7d/30d cadence and a CSV/JSON format.

Ava Kim: Agree. From oncall patterns I've seen, recurring incidents often come from partial fixes. We should require a recurrence check entry in every remediation (did we add monitoring, runbook changes, and deploy guardrails?).

Jordan Lee: Strong 👍. Also propose rotating incident commander (IC) handoff notes be standardized. IC should set the comms cadence at start: initial, 30m, 2hr, final. That way we avoid ad-hoc updates.

Priya Shah: Here's a minimal timeline template I sketched — small enough to paste into a ticket or comment and parse later:

```
Remediation: <short description>
Owner: <name> (team)
Priority: P0/P1/P2
Due: YYYY-MM-DD
Recurrence Check: [monitoring/runbook/deploy-guard]
Status Checkpoints: 72h: <status>, 7d: <status>, 30d: <status>
Postmortem Link: <url>
Notes: <free text>
```

Sam Ortiz: This looks good. If we require that as a comment on the postmortem or the Jira issue, we can run a periodic job that scans for missing fields. Would catch missing owners or due dates.

Ava Kim: On rotation: suggest a 2-week IC cadence for the oncall pool, with explicit handoff doc + quick checklist. I can draft the checklist. Also, can we have the IC gently enforce the remediation SLAs? They already track incident closure.

Jordan Lee: For comms cadence, minimal policy: initial (incident declared), 30m (status/impact), hourly until stabilization, then final summary + follow-up owner assignment within 24h. Keep messages short, link to runbook and status page.

Priya Shah: Good. One more item — recurring incident pattern tracking. We should tag postmortems with failure-mode labels (e.g., cache-thrash, auth-flakiness, infra-deg). Then run a monthly heatmap to prioritize systemic remediations.

Sam Ortiz: Implementation idea: add labels to the PM template, and push them to a small dashboard. I can prototype a script that scans postmortems and counts tags. Output: Slack weekly summary with top-3 recurring patterns.

Ava Kim: Love it. That would help prioritize engineering work vs quick fixes. Also include a field in the template: "Prevented by" for what guard will stop recurrence.

ops-bot: Incident INC-1234 transitioned to remediation phase. Remediation owner assigned: Priya Shah. Due date: 2024-11-12. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1234 :white_check_mark:

Priya Shah: Thanks ops-bot. I'll fill the template in the ticket today. Can we make the 72h and 7d checkpoints automatically ping the owner and the eng-oncall channel?

Sam Ortiz: Yes — webhook to post a reminder card if the status field hasn't changed. We should also record a quick "no-regression check" entry after 30d (simple smoke tests).

Jordan Lee: One governance question: what happens if an owner misses SLA? Proposal: escalate to team lead at 48h and auto-create a follow-up in the remediation board. Keeps momentum.

Ava Kim: Agreed. Escalation should be automatic but visible. No surprise. Ops-bot could send the escalation and copy the team lead.

Priya Shah: OK action items from thread: 1) Sam to prototype scanner + Slack weekly heatmap (owner: Sam, due: 2 weeks). 2) Ava to draft IC handoff checklist + remediation recurrence checklist (owner: Ava, due: 1 week). 3) Priya to author a short RFC for the minimal template + escalation rules (owner: Priya, due: 4 days). 4) Jordan to propose the comms cadence doc and embed in incident runbook (owner: Jordan, due: 4 days). Please confirm.

Sam Ortiz: Confirmed. I'll make a draft repo and ping this channel when ready. :+1:

Ava Kim: Confirmed, drafting now.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed, will link to runbook.

Priya Shah: Thanks — let's land these into INC-1234 and the oncall runbook. If anyone wants to join a short working session tomorrow 10:30am PT, say so.

Sam Ortiz: I'll join.

Ava Kim: I'll be there.

Jordan Lee: Might be in a meeting, but will try to drop by.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 72h checkpoint for INC-1234 will post to #eng-oncall on 3070003954.
